title: Eating well every day
summary: Learn to choose foods that help you grow and give you energy.
keyIdeas: Fruit and vegetables give us vitamins, minerals and fibre.
Water is the best everyday drink to keep us hydrated.
Sweets and cakes are occasional treats.

basicKnowledge: A. Cultura científica › La vida en nuestro planeta

activities.prompt: Lucía feels thirsty after playing tag. Which drink is the healthiest choice?
activities.explanation: Water quenches thirst and is a healthy everyday drink.
activities.hint: It has no sugar or added colours.

activities.prompt: Fruit and vegetables help us care for our health.
activities.explanation: They give us vitamins, minerals and fibre. A varied diet helps keep us healthy.

activities.prompt: Choose the word that completes the sentence.
activities.explanation: We can eat fruit every day, at break time or for dessert.
activities.sentence: To help us grow strong, we eat fresh fruit every ___.

activities.prompt: Sort these foods into their groups.
activities.explanation: Bananas and apples are fruits. Spinach and carrots are nutritious vegetables.

activities.prompt: Match each food to its group.
activities.explanation: An apple is a fruit. Lentils are pulses, and cheese is a dairy food.

activities.prompt: Which is the most balanced snack for Aisha?
activities.explanation: Bread with cheese and tomato, plus fruit, provides energy and different nutrients.
activities.hint: Look for fresh foods and variety.
options: A bag of crisps and packaged juice
A cheese and tomato sandwich with a mandarin

activities.prompt: Which statement about food contains a mistake?
activities.explanation: Whole fruit keeps more fibre than juice. Even juice with no added sugar contains the fruit's sugars.
activities.hint: Think about the fibre in whole fruit.
options: Packaged juice replaces eating whole fruit
Fish and eggs give us protein for muscles

activities.prompt: Two apples are grown in the same way. One travels less and uses less plastic. Which saves transport and packaging?
activities.explanation: In this case, the nearby apple saves transport and packaging. A food's impact also depends on how it is grown.
activities.hint: Compare the apples' journeys and packaging.
options: The apple that travelled far in a plastic box
The local apple, because it needs less transport

activities.prompt: Read Nerea's story and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Fresh garden vegetables provide useful nutrients for our bodies.
activities.title: Grandma's garden
activities.text: Nerea visits her grandmother in the countryside. They pick red tomatoes and green lettuces. Grandma makes a fresh salad with olive oil. Nerea tastes the green leaves and smiles. The freshly picked vegetables taste delicious!

questions.prompt: What do Nerea and her grandmother pick?
questions.explanation: The text says they pick tomatoes and lettuces.
Vegetables provide nutrients and fibre. They are part of a varied diet.
options: It has lots of sugar and chocolate
Vegetables provide vitamins, minerals and fibre
